title: fix(v2): tolerate deferred MCP transforms
description:
## Summary
- Do not assume the v2 MCP transform callback runs synchronously during plugin setup.
- Capture a deferred MCP draft when the host invokes the callback; startup and ordinary prompts remain available before then.
- Add deferred-callback coverage and validate a packed artifact with a real OpenCode v2 prompt run.

## Verification
- `bun run check:ci`
- `bun run typecheck`
- `bun test` — 4,323 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed
- `bun run build`
- `bun run verify:release`
- Packed-artifact OpenCode v2 prompt smoke (`opencode run --log-level debug`) — exit 0, no MCP snapshot crash

bugs.summary: captureAgentDraft stores the agent editor in pendingAgentDraft, and finalizeAgentDraft never clears it after applying the registry projection. Every later MCP transform callback (the host replays it on MCP-only rebuilds) calls finalizeAgentDraft(pendingAgentDraft) again, re-applying the cached projection to already published agents: downstream model, permission and default-agent changes are silently overwritten through a stale editor, without an agent update notification.
bugs.trigger: Finalize agents (agent and MCP transforms both ran), let downstream code change an agent's model/permissions or the default agent, then have the host replay the MCP transform callback: the explorer agent's model and permissions are reset to the plugin's projection.
